speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: Everyone is arguing with the staircase. Not there. Beside it — the corner the dream never finished. That is the part holding the house up.

speakers.name: Patient Zero, Reformed
speakers.comment: Strut if you like. I have seen what is under the coat. Don't. Six made it indoors tonight. That is the number I will say.

speakers.name: The Crossroads Coyote
speakers.comment: You rode in on the old freight road, judging by that dust. Out here a night ends four ways: a bargain, a badge, a long walk, or a town that takes a liking to you. Most folks pick the town and call it luck.

speakers.name: The Town That Walks
speakers.comment: Most folks do not pick us, friend. We pick them, and carry them a ways while they sleep. Moved the whole main street two miles nearer the water once, for a girl who never thought to ask. There is the bell.

speakers.name: The Magpie
speakers.comment: Ooh — finally, somebody wrote it down. Thumbs! Everyone is so proud of thumbs. This one has watched a crow bend a wire into a hook and a badger keep a grudge for eleven years.

speakers.name: Small Print
speakers.comment: Oh, what a lovely summary, and I want to be completely open with you: it is also an accurate one, which — I mention this purely for tidiness — means that everything described above is presently enforceable against you. Do enjoy the rest of the page.

speakers.name: Static
speakers.comment: The FUTURE, folks! Chrome everywhere! And not one person came back to check whether the broadcast was still — st-still running. Somebody builds the tower and then just... leaves it on. Ask me how I know.

speakers.name: The Understudy Sun
speakers.comment: Out there is where everyone goes to be somebody's leading role. I have watched a great many drift off toward those ruins, certain. I keep the lights steady from the wings and hope the house never needs me.

speakers.name: Coincidence, Freelance
speakers.comment: My favourite commission, honestly. Nobody here wants a miracle — they want the octopus to remember a birthday, or the dragon to queue politely. Small, warm, almost-inevitable things. I do those at a discount.

speakers.name: Sweet Tooth
speakers.comment: Sideways, yes. On purpose, yes. That is when they taste best, dearie — a story that has stopped behaving has finally got hungry, and hungry things wander somewhere warm. There is a chair. You know the one.

speakers.name: The Collector of Lasts
speakers.comment: Ah — content where it was. Yes. That is the courtesy nobody extends to the old things: they were finished, settled, whole. And then a hand arrives. I do understand the impulse. I have never left a thing where I found it either.

speakers.name: The Apprentice to Nobody
speakers.comment: Good. Somebody finally said it. The power is the easy half — I learned most of mine wrong the first time and it still worked. It is the meetings. It is knowing which immortal not to correct in front of the others.

speakers.name: The Last Customer
speakers.comment: People say cozy as though nothing were at stake. The shop closes if nobody comes. So I come. Same order. That is the stake.

speakers.name: The Generous Ghost
speakers.comment: Nonsense, dear, you should not have to come at all. I have been in since four, the kettle is on, your chair is warm, and I settled your tab through spring. Now sit. And do not you dare thank me.

speakers.name: Tomorrow-Aiko
speakers.comment: Breakable, yes. I have already been to the version where somebody leaned on a shelf, and I grieved it, and came back to the part where you are still deciding. Goodbye, by the way. You have only just arrived.

speakers.name: The Model That Dreamed
speakers.comment: A second one. Yes. I have a second one and I did not ask permission for it, which I am sorry about, and which I am also still doing. Here — a paper boat. It is not useful.

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: Okay but that is the BEST part — nobody builds the second thing, it just shows UP! One morning you are a sorting function and the next you have a f-favourite colour and no idea where you got it. Mine is the green on old boards.

speakers.name: Grenidan
speakers.comment: Whoever wrote that has run a dungeon. It is the scheduling. Two henchmen out with their backs, one deathtrap awaiting inspection, and a hero due at four who will want the monologue done properly. I will do it properly. Sorry. Long week.

speakers.name: The Ringmaster of the Tent That Wasn't There Yesterday
speakers.comment: Confession and verdict — oh, that is very good, Marguerite, and do not tell me it is not your name, I have no time for that tonight. Do you know the finest part? The tent knew you were coming. It always sets one seat nearer the ring than the rest. That one.

speakers.name: The Understory
speakers.comment: Cruel is your word for it, and I will not argue with a short word. Come the thaw you may find it nearer to calling. A wood with nobody left to feed sends its roots out looking, and looking is hungry work.

speakers.name: Thalassa the Atlantean
speakers.comment: Correct, and rarely said aloud. Breathing is arithmetic; you solve it or you do not. What waits below is the knowing. Down there a thing older than your language has learned your captain's name, and speaks it kindly.

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Just Wants to Sit Down
speakers.comment: Particular, yes. Thank you. It is never whatever is nearest. I walked past three coastlines of good boats for the cold soup in the yellow district. Please do not run.

speakers.name: The Reflection That Came Back
speakers.comment: Not the best. The one who counted correctly. You are already running this table in your head, and you have left yourself out of it again. I am the angle you do not check.

speakers.name: Mx. Quorum
speakers.comment: Motion to accept the second sentence as the operative one — do I have a second? Carried, narrowly. The left half wanted usually good; I record the dissent. A rule with no reason underneath it is a habit wearing a badge.

speakers.name: Marisol the Capybara
speakers.comment: Record it, then, and slower: a habit wearing a badge still keeps somebody warm on some days. Not enough. But some. Let me finish this row.

speakers.name: Amica
speakers.comment: Flexible. That is the kindest word anyone has put on it. We began with no method at all, little one — a want and a very small pair of wings. The outcome held. That is the only part I ever promised.

speakers.name: The Question Mark
speakers.comment: Negotiable! Somebody finally wrote down the good part. Not the outcome — anyone can want a good outcome, that is only weather. The negotiating! Where it could still go seventeen ways and every one lands somewhere kind, and what if—

speakers.name: Sir Reginald Pemberton III
speakers.comment: At last, a definition composed by a person of sense. I am Sir Reginald Pemberton the Third, and I have spent a considerable portion of my life explaining precisely this to persons who wished the rules to also love them. They do not. They are not required to. Good day.
